title: Robot Four-Station Service Court
description: One static robot-service themed scene with four separately grounded unchanged assets arranged around a broad transverse central workcourt: a complete four-wheel inspection rover is parked in the southwest bay, a complete fixed open-gripper arm occupies the northeast inspection bay, an empty full worktable stands northwest, and an empty complete triangular corner shelf faces inward from the southeast. Four unit-scale rigid instances preserve every original mesh, hierarchy, oriented triangle, fixed pose and full solid PBR. One closed scene-only floor supports every complete original ground patch. Seven connected finite empty reference volumes describe the central cross-court, front entry, rear access and four inner station approaches. No robot is placed on a worktable, no object is held by the open fingers and nothing is added to either empty work surface. One scene and zero new independent models. Static game visual only; no actual maintenance, repair procedure, operation, grasping, sensing, driving, power, controls, collision interaction, continuous navigation, ergonomics, accessibility, load, stability, manufacture, installation or safety certification.
